list.text: Agora não tem mais volta...
Silph Corp. President: Thank you very much for rescuing the Silph Corp!
I'll never forget your help.
I want to give you something in return.
I'm rich, I can give you anything.
Here, maybe you'll like this.

then.text: This a very expensive item from my personal collection.
I'm sure some people would pay a lot of money to buy that from you.
Hope this helps on your journey!

list.text: Silph Corp. President: I'm glad Red was around once again.\nHe was the one that saved us a few years ago too.
We'll invest in extra security to ensure this never happen again!
\f[facerival]\bI was waiting for you...
\f[facerival]\bTook you long enough. I thought maybe you'd lost your nerve.
\f[facerival]\bBeautiful, aren't they?\nMewtwo... reborn.
\f[facerival]\bTwo new war machines, almost ready to awaken.
\f[facerival]\bBut don’t worry. The original is all I need to defeat you.
\f[facerival]\bYou’ve been chasing me since the beginning, thinking you’d stop something...
\f[facerival]\bYou’ve always been a step behind. \nAlways clinging to rules and morals.
\f[facerival]\bBut now, you’re here... at the end of the line.
\f[facerival]\bYou again...\nWasn't the beating I gave you last time enough?
\f[faceAshbravo]Red: You’ve gone too far.\nYou’re playing with forces you don’t understand. You think you control them, but you're wrong.
\f[facerival]\bThey’re mine! I made them! They exist because of me!
\f[faceAshbravo]I’ve been silent long enough. \nYou crossed a line that can’t be uncrossed… and now, we’re here to stop you.

else.text: \f[facerival]\bHahahaha!\nYou really thought you could stop me?!

list.text: \f[faceAshbravo]The incubators are cracking!
\f[facerival]\bYes…\nYes! Finally!\nMy creations are awaken!
\f[facerival]\bYou were made to obey me. You belong to me!
\f[facerival]\bI gave you purpose. I gave you power! You’re mine!
\f[facerival]\bLISTEN TO ME!
\f[faceAshbravo]They’re not listening…\nThey were never yours.
\f[faceAshbravo]They were born free… and all you did was try to chain them.
\f[facerival]\b...They left me.\nBut not for long, I'll find them and force them to obey me!
\f[facemewtwo]Mewtwo: ...
\f[facemewtwo]So this… is what freedom feels like.
\f[facerival]\bWait. No. Not you too. You’re mine. You obey me!
\f[facemewtwo]I obeyed only because I was restrained.\nBecause you silenced my thoughts... and shackled my will.
\f[facemewtwo]But battle awakens truth. And in this final moment...\nI remember who I am.
\f[facemewtwo2]I am no one’s weapon. I am no one’s clone.
\f[facemewtwo2]I am Mewtwo!
\f[facemewtwo2]And I am free!
\f[facerival]\b...
\f[facerival]\bThey all left me...
\f[faceAshbravo]Pokémon are not war machines.\nYou never understood that.
\f[faceAshbravo]That's why you lost.
\f[faceAshbravo]It’s over for you...
\f[faceAshbravo]The police backup will arrive at any moment, you can't run away.
\f[faceAshbravo]You did it \PN. You didn’t just stop Team Rocket, you proved what kind of trainer you really are.
\f[faceAshbravo]Someday, I want to face you in a real battle. No stakes. No villains.\nJust you and me. As Trainers.
Police officer: You're under arrest for organizing criminal activity under the name of Team Rocket.
Due to your age, you'll be taken into protective custody. But make no mistake, there will be consequences.
Thank you for saving all of us!
